title: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting, June 3 to 5, 2026
description: [Under Section 45ZL of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934] The sixty first meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC), constituted under Section 45ZB of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, was held during June 3 to 5, 2026. 2.
